ctx.x: You see, I ring it for, for something like, alright, for Sunday school. You understand? Well, now, like, if your husband is Baptist, well, you're Baptist, well, your child go to Sunday school, alright, well, I ring it for Sunday school, 10 o'clock for Sunday school. Now, I ring it for Sunday school, about 11, but half past 11, I ring it again. Well, now, I ring it, now, that's for, that's for service, you see, for 11 o'clock service. Now, I don't ring it until about 6, 6.30, 6 or 7, 7.30. Well, now, at 7.30, I…
Well, what's the difference between ringing it and telling it?
